plan: Open items of the roadmap in the 2027 readiness report (Downloads: Laravel starter kit AI era readiness.md, section Roadmap)
baseline: Checked against the kit files at ebe084e on 2026-11-21. D1, D7 and D8 are built and tracked in todo/agent-dx.status.json; the four deferred-by-decision items stay off this file.

phases.name: SchemaConventionTest holds rules 1, 2, 5, 6 and 10 over a table classification map, and a fixture that breaks each rule turns it red
phases.command: vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/Conventions/SchemaConventionTest.php --compact --no-coverage --fail-on-skipped && bin/prove-control.sh schema-table-without-primary-key SchemaConventionTest 'primary key' && bin/prove-control.sh schema-unclassified-table SchemaConventionTest 'classif' && bin/prove-control.sh schema-tenant-table-without-index SchemaConventionTest 'organization_id' && bin/prove-control.sh schema-tenant-unique-without-organization SchemaConventionTest 'unique' && bin/prove-control.sh schema-money-as-decimal SchemaConventionTest 'money' && bin/prove-control.sh schema-redundant-index SchemaConventionTest 'redundant'
phases.note: Open part of D2: the classification map, the allow-list and rules 1, 2, 5, 6 and 10 (the index rules 2 and 3 shipped in 7560e78). The report's Done when names only the tenant-index fixture; one fixture per rule is added so each rule is proven to bite. Rule 4 moves to D3 with the other source rules. Patch names are provisional until the contract freezes.

phases.name: Migration-source rules 4, 11 and 13 trip an AST test, and the commit hooks refuse an edit to a migration already on main
phases.command: bin/prove-control.sh migration-foreign-key-without-on-delete SchemaConventionTest 'on delete' && bin/prove-control.sh migration-drop-without-marker SchemaConventionTest 'marker' && bin/prove-control.sh migration-without-down SchemaConventionTest 'down' && bin/prove-control.sh migration-raw-sql-without-driver-check SchemaConventionTest 'driver' && vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Docs/MergedMigrationHookTest.php --compact --no-coverage
phases.note: Derived: the report's hook clause (a staged M of 0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php makes the hook exit non-zero) is decided by MergedMigrationHookTest, which stages that edit in a scratch clone and runs the hook. The escape for an owner-approved in-place edit is an owner decision.

phases.name: A staged migration or snapshot runs SchemaConventionTest in pre-commit, and the Claude and Codex hooks ask before a migration write, a destructive migrate command and a commit that stages a snapshot
phases.note: Derived: the report's behavioural clauses (visible in hook output, hook returns an ask in both agents) are decided by DatabaseHookTest, which feeds tool-call JSON to both guard-gates.sh copies and runs pre-commit's test selection on a staged migration. This item also closes the hook-ask part of D6.

phases.name: database/snapshots holds one sorted text file per table, a stale snapshot fails with the regenerate command in the message, and pre-commit prints the staged snapshot diff
phases.note: The commit-output clause (pre-commit shows the snapshot diff) is asserted in DatabaseHookTest under D4.

phases.name: Human design gate: CODEOWNERS entry, pull request design note, schema criteria in contract and deepen, and the four trigger prompts run per agent
phases.note: Open part of D6 only; the rule file, skill, SKILLS entry, AGENTS.md lines and index row shipped as agent-dx phase 26. Each file is checked on its own because the report's rg over two files passes on index.md alone. The hook ask is decided under D4. The prompt-run clause is manual; the file check is a placeholder until the owner names the agents, then it counts one result per prompt per agent.

phases.name: Content-level tamper guard: a commit that adds a PHPStan ignore, grows a baseline, adds a skip marker or lowers a composer.json threshold is refused without a trailer
phases.command: vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Docs/TamperGuardTest.php --compact --no-coverage && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r1-off TamperGuardTest 'R1 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r2-off TamperGuardTest 'R2 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r3-off TamperGuardTest 'R3 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r4-off TamperGuardTest 'R4 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r5-off TamperGuardTest 'R5 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-r6-off TamperGuardTest 'R6 refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-unwired TamperGuardTest 'commit-msg refuses' && bin/prove-control.sh tamper-guard-bare-trailer TamperGuardTest 'Gate-Change does not count'
phases.note: TamperGuardTest feeds one fixture diff per rule to the check and asserts it exits non-zero, and that the trailer lets it through. The check reads the commit message, so it runs from commit-msg, not pre-commit (pre-commit cannot see the message).

phases.name: Agent permission and sandbox baseline committed for Claude, Codex and OpenCode, with a convention test that the keys exist
phases.note: Derived: the report's behavioural clause (a Read of .env in a fresh Claude session is refused, .env.example succeeds) is manual; its result is written once to todo/roadmap-verification.md, the form todo/platform-ops-verification.md uses.

phases.name: Composer native cooldown set, and a convention test fails when either release-age key (composer.json, bunfig.toml) is removed

phases.command: ! jq -e '."require-dev" | has("laravel/vet")' composer.json >/dev/null && ! jq -e '.config."allow-plugins" | has("laravel/vet")' composer.json >/dev/null && [ ! -e vet.json ] && ! jq -e '.config.audit."ignore-abandoned" | index("laravel/vet")' composer.json >/dev/null
